rows.text: Based on recent activity and results to date, the Company has raised its 2026 full-year guidance ranges for net income, FFO and FFO as Adjusted, estimating net income of $0.86 to $0.88 per diluted share, net income attributable to common shareholders of $0.82 to $0.84 per diluted share, FFO of $1.59 to $1.61 per diluted share, and FFO as Adjusted of $1.52 to $1.54 per diluted share.
